data.name: Dia Youssef Hafed
data.description: Dia Youssef Hafed is an architecture student at Lebanese University, Faculty of Fine Arts & Architecture in Tripoli, with experience in architectural drawing, residential design, renovation, and 3D visualization.
data.footer: Architecture, design development & visualization — Akkar, Lebanon.

title: Architecture shaped by curiosity, craft, and place.
subtitle: Architecture / Spatial design
body: I’m Dia Youssef Hafed, an architecture student at Lebanese University. I work across design development, technical drawing, and architectural visualization, and I’m eager to keep learning through practice.

title: Architecture portfolio
subtitle: Studies in space, form, and material.
body: A small set of speculative concept studies is here to preview the portfolio layout and category filters. These are sample-only design exercises, not verified projects from Dia's CV or built work.

items.title: Courtyard House
items.subtitle: Speculative concept / Residential
items.body: SAMPLE CONCEPT — not a commissioned or built project. A compact home is organized around a planted courtyard, bringing soft daylight and cross-ventilation into the rooms while creating a quiet center for everyday life. Replace this study with a verified project from Dia's portfolio.

data.image_alt: Speculative residential concept illustration created as portfolio sample data; not a completed project

10, 14.3, 32, 21.4 | Living room | 6.4 × 3.0 m | Wide glazing opens toward the courtyard, so daylight reaches the back of the room.

10, 35.7, 30, 28.6 | Study | 6.0 × 4.0 m | A quiet room on the west side. The courtyard tree filters the afternoon light.
40, 35.7, 20, 28.6 | Courtyard | 4.0 × 4.0 m | The open centre of the house: planted, shaded and cross-ventilated. Every room borrows its light from here.
60, 35.7, 30, 28.6 | Bedroom | 6.0 × 4.0 m | Turns toward the courtyard rather than the street, for privacy and soft morning light.
10, 64.3, 20, 21.4 | Entry | 4.0 × 3.0 m | A compressed threshold. The view into the courtyard only opens once you step inside.

title: About Dia
subtitle: Architecture student · Lebanese University
body: Motivated architecture student at the Lebanese University – Faculty of Fine Arts & Architecture, passionate about design development and architectural visualization. Skilled in creating detailed drawings and realistic 3D models, and eager to gain practical experience while developing professional skills.
